summary: AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer for Students - A full-stack web application that analyzes student resumes using NLP, compares extracted skills with industry job role requirements, identifies skill gaps, and provides personalized recommendations with downloadable PDF reports.
architectural_notes: Frontend: React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS for responsive UI
Backend: Motoko canisters for data storage (users, resumes, job roles, skills)
NLP Integration: Frontend TypeScript calls external NLP APIs for text extraction
Authentication: Internet Identity integration (passkeys, Google, Apple, Microsoft)
Data Storage: Resumes stored permanently in canisters with analysis history
Admin Access: Role-based access control for job role and skills management
Skills Structure: Includes proficiency levels and skill categories (Technical/Soft)
Matching Algorithm: TF-IDF with cosine similarity for skill comparison
PDF Generation: Frontend JavaScript library for report generation
REST API Architecture: Modular canister methods with proper error handling

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system using Internet Identity integration allowing users to register and login with passkeys, Google, Apple, or Microsoft accounts
